jobs.title: Rotational Product Manager
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Meta's Rotational Product Manager (RPM) opportunity is a growth accelerator, Short-Term Employment (STE) Program designed to rapidly build the skills and competencies needed to become a successful Product Manager at Meta. We encourage candidates who have non-traditional career paths to apply, including, but not limited to, candidates with experiences outside of the technical industry. We are looking for future product leaders who bring diversity of thought, skills, perspectives, and experiences to the Product Management function so we can continue building global products for billions of users.

As an RPM, you will channel your passion for building industry leading products and creative problem-solving skills. During product group rotations, you will drive product development alongside a team of engineers and designers. You'll integrate usability studies, research, and market analysis into product requirements to maximize user satisfaction. You'll also define and analyze metrics that ensure the success of products.
